Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. RT initial growth in smooth Boussinesq double layers Advance the actual2D Boussinesq vorticity/active-buoyancy system and compare smooth unstable-layer growth with a separately derived linear IVP. Assumptions, units and boundaries Periodic[0,2pi]², layer width.25, nu=kappa=.005, epsilon1e-5 and32²/64²/128² grids. Explicit forcing maintains the base. g1,b0=.02tanh(sin y/delta),rho/rho0=1-b/g,T2. Density enters buoyancy only; this is not variable-density Euler. Editorial clarification Small-amplitude fixed educational cases. The independent reference changes spatial representation but linearizes the PDE; it is not a second nonlinear engine. No sharp-interface infinite-domain dispersion, original compressible McNally inputs, late roll-up or RT turbulence claim. Figures explicitly normalize computed perturbations by epsilon. Adopted numerical method Advance point-sampled perturbations using centered shared-face conservative fluxes and Heun; invert the five-point Poisson symbol by FFT. Centered derivatives define divergence-free velocity.
